cases.title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions
cases.why_primary: The paper is clearly in scope neighborhood-wise, but its empirical validation story is reported in a mixed and incomplete way. That makes the stage-2 exclusion understandable even though gold keeps the record positive.
cases.why_not_other_two: It is not reviewer_semantic_gap because the reviewer followed real cautionary language in the paper, and it is not criteria_or_gold_tension because the current criteria and gold can still be reconciled if the validation evidence were stated more concretely.

cases.title: Step-Audio: Unified Understanding and Generation in Intelligent Speech Interaction
cases.why_primary: The abstract mentions only benchmarked human evaluation, but the full text later makes the preference-learning pipeline explicit: RLHF, chosen/rejected pairs, reward-model training, and PPO. The decisive learning signal is hidden outside the title/abstract surface.
cases.why_not_other_two: It is not reviewer_semantic_gap because the reviewer only had evaluation-looking abstract language to work with, and it is not criteria_or_gold_tension because the full paper clearly supports gold positivity under the active criteria.
